SettingsItem.Name: Resample exposure response function values
SettingsItem.Description: Specifies whether exposure response function values are resampled.

SettingsItem.Name: Resample counter factual values
SettingsItem.Description: Specifies whether the counter factual values are resampled from a parametric uncertainty distribution.

SettingsItem.Name: Exposure grouping method
SettingsItem.Description: Specify the method by which the exposures are grouped in bins. For 'Custom bins', the specified bins are used for all exposure response functions. For 'ERF-defined bins', the bins defined for subgroups are used and for exposure response functions without subgroups, the specified custom bins are used.
